reading.action: Step back into the entrance to deny the Stalker freedom of movement; wait for it to commit to the doorway, then unload the heaviest Ember Wave he can manage, channeled through the Furnace-heart — fire+light into the choke. 'Let's see how the night likes meeting the sun.'

combat.note: NAT 20 / CRIT. Essence (ment) attack: power INT*1.2+WILL=39.8 vs the Stalker's LOW WILL mentDef 13. Perfect read -> intent 9 (choke kills mobility, light is its bane [seen t57], commitment-timing, grounded-not-baited, wave fills the doorway = no evasion). gate ×1.8 = the DESIGNED lit/cornered multiplier. 168 dmg overkills 98 HP -> CLEAN KILL. Designed flame-recoil + the kill => it never strikes; Alan takes 0.

levelup.note: Engine xpToNext(4)=200 (authority already on level×50). 230>=200 -> LEVEL 5, carry 30. xpToNext(5)=250 == the already-displayed xpMax -> the L4 250->200 display drift RESOLVES by leveling; hud.xpMax NOT manually touched. +3 points UNSPENT.
